title: Recovering Wasted Compute in Autoresearch Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.10424v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A slew of recent works develop agents for solving research problems end-to-end, a paradigm increasingly referred to as autoresearch. Such agents have inspired large industry investment, motivated by their potential to automate time-consuming human labor and customize machine learning solutions for specialized applications. In this paper, we study the modeling pipeline at the core of these autoresearch systems and identify common failure modes when they are applied to tabular datasets: (1) they waste compute resolving the same bugs over and over again; (2) they often fail to tune hyperparameters even when they have a large remaining compute budget; (3) the tree-search algorithms that power them do not explore; and (4) they perform data analysis, mimicking the humans whose data they are trained on, but do not use that analysis to make downstream decisions. translated_title: 恢复自动研究智能体中被浪费的计算资源
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.10424v2 公告类型：替换。摘要：近期大量研究工作开发了能够端到端解决研究问题的智能体，这一范式日益被称为“自动研究”。此类智能体因具有自动化耗时人类劳动、并为专业应用定制机器学习解决方案的潜力，激发了大规模的产业投资。本文研究了这些自动研究系统核心的建模流程，并识别出它们在应用于表格数据集时的常见失败模式：(1) 它们反复解决相同的bug，浪费计算资源；(2) 即使拥有大量剩余计算预算，它们也常常未能调优超参数；(3) 支撑它们的树搜索算法缺乏探索性；(4) 它们会进行数据分析，模仿其训练数据中的人类行为，但并不利用这些分析来做下游决策。我们探索了针对性的干预措施，并发现一个全局调试顾问能够……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文识别出自动研究智能体在处理表格数据时的四种常见失败模式——重复修复相同bug浪费算力、即使算力充足也不调优超参数、树搜索算法缺乏探索、数据分析结果未被用于下游决策——并提出包括全局调试顾问在内的针对性干预措施，以回收被浪费的计算资源。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies four common failure modes of autoresearch agents on tabular datasets—wasting compute on repeatedly fixing the same bugs, failing to tune hyperparameters despite remaining budget, unexplorative tree-search, and data analysis not informing downstream decisions—and proposes targeted interventions such as a global debug consultant to recover wasted compute.
